sources.title: Roblox Unveils Cube 3D Open-Source AI Model Simplifying 3D ... - WinBuzzer
sources.snippet: Cube 3D by Roblox is an open-source AI model that accelerates 3D content creation, allowing developers to generate detailed assets using straightforward prompts.

sources.title: GitHub - myoshikawa47/act
sources.snippet: This repo contains the implementation of ACT, together with 2 simulated environments: Transfer Cube and Bimanual Insertion. You can train and evaluate ACT in sim or real.
